svg.title: PDBlend: request routing and per-instance scheduling
svg.desc: Default single-pool PDBlend with vLLM V1 continuous batching. The router uses input length and lexicographic load selection. Local waiting queues default to FCFS; running requests are scheduled first. P sends KV and the first token to continue on D. Mixed batches can contain prefill and decode together. Numerical loads and timelines are illustrative, not benchmark measurements.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif
